title: Fusion Component Spec v1
description: The durable component contract. This — not the .comp or .setting file — is what everything else contracts against. Fusion's serialization format is Blackmagic's, undocumented and version-drifting; a compiled .comp is build output, like a .o file. When Resolve changes that format, one emitter changes and every component declared here survives. `consumes` and `motion` are not documentation: the theme-binding test and verification gate 2 are generated from them, so a wrong declaration fails the build rather than misleading a reader.

name.description: kebab-case, named for what it DOES, never how it looks. `callout`, not `ink-callout`.

version.description: Bump on any change to structure, params or motion. Bumping invalidates every approval record keyed to the old version.

route.description: 1 = compiled to an alpha master and placed on an overlay track (recurring, text-bearing graphics; cached by content hash). 2 = comp attached directly to the plate clip, so MediaIn1 is the plate and the component can mask, displace and multiply INTO it. Route decides which form of verification gate 2 applies.

consumes.description: Theme tokens this component reads. Enforced BOTH ways by tests/test_theme_binding.py: changing a listed token must change the compiled graph (catches a component that ignores the theme and hardcodes), and changing an unlisted one must not (catches undeclared coupling).

params.description: Typed parameters the caller supplies per instance.

duration.description: How the component behaves when its clip is trimmed. Route 1 components must use anim-curves so a trim stretches the motion instead of clipping it (docs/MOTION-GRAPHICS.md); Route 2 comps are bound to one clip's duration and may use fixed keyframes.

motion.description: Declared motion windows. Gate 2 is GENERATED from this: inside a window the rendered inter-frame delta must exceed a floor, outside every window it must be about zero, and changed pixels must fall inside `region`. An empty array declares a component that never moves, and gate 2 will then require that it never moves.

from.description: frame, or fraction of duration when duration.mode is anim-curves

region.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in normalised frame coordinates. The changed-pixel bounding box must sit inside this. A component that declares the full frame [0,0,1,1] is asserting it legitimately repaints everything, and should say so deliberately.
